name: analyzing-corporate-tax-structures
description: Evaluates U.S. domestic entity choice and corporate tax structure: C corporation versus S corporation versus LLC or partnership on both layers (21 percent corporate rate plus dividend and NIIT tax, against owner rates net of the Section 199A deduction), break-even payout, and exit under Section 1202 QSBS (pre- and post-July 4, 2025 regimes, gross assets test, holding period tiers, per-issuer cap). Tests S corporation eligibility and one class of stock under Treas. Reg. 1.1361-1(l); Section 1374 built-in gains; LLC to corporation conversions; consolidated return eligibility under Section 1504 and the 1.1502 regulations; accumulated earnings and personal holding company tax; corporate AMT status with controlled-group aggregation; and state PTE elections under the SALT cap. Use for entity selection, S election, QSBS, holding company or consolidated group questions. Hands cross-border structures, transfer pricing and acquisition structuring to sibling skills. Drafts for qualified tax adviser review.
